Counts as a <strand/>Strand Weapon for most armor mods. <solar/>Solar Explosion will only be buffed by Solar Surge mods. 

Hold down the trigger to charge this weapon's rocket through three stages. Upon reaching the first stage, a high damage delayed <solar/>Solar Explosive is added to the rocket, which detonates after 1? second and deals damage in a 10 meter radius. 

Holding down the trigger for 0.4 seconds after reaching maximum charge automatically fires the rocket. At base, it takes 4.85 seconds to fully charge Whirling Ovation

Benefits at 33%-66%|66%-99%|100% Charge Level:
• 207%|315%|525% overall damage increase
• 55%|109%|212% increased impact damage
• [-]% |35%|52% increased explosion damage
